emily nguyen: FYI — during vuln triage we pulled a set of logs that we need to keep accessible longer than standard retention. Need input on SIEM export TTL and access method :thinking_face:

raj patel: what retention are you thinking?

emily nguyen: for the incident we need 180 days for the raw event slice (for replay). But don't want to change org-wide retention. Proposal: export slice to ephemeral bucket with 180d TTL and gated access. Thoughts?

olivia chen: +1 to ephemeral bucket. We should encrypt with a CMK and require KMS unwrapping via a short-lived role.

michael torres: we already have kms-proxy for JIT unseal. Need to confirm policy: only analysts with 'forensics:temp_viewer' can call UnwrapKey. Also require ticket id and approval in metadata.

sarah kim: add audit meta to the exported objects: ticket id, requestor, approver, and hash of the export. This ensures integrity checks.

emily nguyen: good. How do we prevent accidental extension of TTL? Attack surface: if RBAC is too broad, someone could re-export.

raj patel: enforce policy in export pipeline — prohibit ReWriteTTL API unless actor in 'retention-admin' group. Also log that action to SIEM with 'ttl_change' event.

olivia chen: for SIEM copies, we should redact PII before export. If full fidelity needed for forensics, store encrypted raw logs in bucket with strict access and keep redacted SIEM copy for analysts.

michael torres: sample policy snippet:
```
allow = {
 "action": "kms:Decrypt",
 "resource": "arn:aws:kms:...:key/forensic-cmk",
 "condition": {
  "request.ticket_id": "present",
  "request.ttl_max": "<=180d"
 }
}
```

sarah kim: we also need an automated rotation for the CMK that doesn't break access during triage — set rotation window + JIT rewrap via key-rotation-playbook.

sec-bot: Policy change request created IR-2026-07 by emily nguyen. Link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/IR-2026-07 :white_check_mark:

emily nguyen: Action items: 1) @raj create ticket with explicit RBAC change for 'forensics:temp_viewer' 2) @olivia update export pipeline to add ticket metadata and TTL guard 3) @michael add kms policy snippet and playbook 4) @sarah add audit fields and PII redaction checklist. I'll coordinate with legal for 180d justification.

raj patel: on it. I'll PR the IAM role, add approval workflow, and include the SIEM alert for ttl_change. ETA EOD tomorrow.

olivia chen: will open PR for pipeline changes, add unit tests for TTL guard.

michael torres: will draft KMS policy and rotation notes.

sarah kim: drafting redaction checklist now.

emily nguyen: thanks. keeping this thread for follow-ups. :lock:
